QuestInfo.name: Catch the Shadow Knight!
QuestInfo.0: You passed #p2091007#'s test. You should now talk to #b#p2091007##k in #b#m925020000##k and find out more about the Seal Stone. You can get there by going through the back alley that #p2091005# told you about.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2091007# says the Seal Stone of #m250000000# is in the #m925040100#. There's a hint to how to get there in one of the lanterns that the panda at the #b#m250000100##k's entrance is holding.
Find the #blantern with the word Entrance engraved on it#k and say the password. The password is '#bActions speak louder than words#k.'
Go to #m925040100#, stop the #r#o9300351##k, and return to Mu Gong
QuestInfo.2: You defeated #o9300351# in #m925040100#, but the Seal Stone of #m250000000# was taken from you by the Gentleman of the Black Wings. It seems to be a recurring pattern. When you told #p2091007# that the Seal Stone was stolen, he admitted that he himself did not know the true use of that stone and reassured you that all is well in #m250000000# even if the Seal Stone has been taken.

mob.0: Examine the lantern held by the panda at the entrance to Mu Lung. One of the #blanterns has the word 'Entrance' engraved#k on it. You must find it to enter the Sealed Temple. The password is '#bActions speak louder than words#k'...
